# OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator v0.13.7

Changes since v0.13.6, released 2026-10-10.

## New

- Switch Chat and Terminal interfaces instantly (#6486)
- Keep macOS AO running after desktop quit (#6472)
- Add Command Code TUI support with hooks, restore and --effort (#5959)

## Fixed

- Refuse to rename the project orchestrator (#6475) (#6499)
- Make light-mode settings row background transparent (#6498)
- WebGL past 16 terminals, batched output frames, faster terminal open (#6465)
- Suppress autohand reviewer login browser (#6474)
- Centralize hidden daemon subprocesses (#6467)
- Tighten composer toolbar and drop custom model entry (#6480)

_Draft from the git history. Edit before you publish._
